key_findings: NGF upregulates CCL19 in rat trigeminal ganglia during experimental tooth movement, and CCL19 exacerbates tooth movement pain (reduced bite force)
CGRP-expressing TG neurons also express CCL19; anti-CCL19 partially relieves NGF-induced pain
